Compiles composed DECIDE/FINALIZE definitions for each critical kind × mutation

intent, warms the in-process registry, and (unless --dry-run) upserts

pipeline_definition objects in CAS.

  Compile without writing
  zqk.test system kernel-integrity compose --dry-run
  Materialize or refresh pipeline_definition rows
  zqk.test system kernel-integrity compose

Usage:
  zqk.test system kernel-integrity compose [flags]

Flags:
      --dry-run            Compile and list titles only; do not write pipeline_definition objects
  -f, --format string      Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
  -o, --output string      Write output to file
  -q, --quiet              Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration   Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose            Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
